title: Frontend: Timeline event components for all event types
description: Create individual timeline event renderers for each of the 8 event types: journal, milestone_completed, todo_batch, github_commit, github_release, progress_change, points_change, status_change.
acceptanceCriteria: Each event type has a distinct icon and color
journal: BookOpen icon, renders title and mood emoji
milestone_completed: Trophy icon, renders milestone name and points awarded
github_commit: GitCommit icon, renders SHA, message (truncated), author
github_release: Tag icon, renders version tag and AI summary if available
progress_change: TrendingUp icon, renders from% → to% with manual indicator
points_change: Star icon, renders delta (+/-) and reason
status_change: Circle icon, renders old status → new status

steps.details: Create src/components/project/timeline/TimelineEventRenderer.tsx. Takes event: TimelineEvent as prop. Switch on event.type to render the appropriate sub-component.

Create one component per event type in src/components/project/timeline/events/: JournalEvent.tsx, MilestoneCompletedEvent.tsx, GithubCommitEvent.tsx, GithubReleaseEvent.tsx, ProgressChangeEvent.tsx, PointsChangeEvent.tsx, StatusChangeEvent.tsx. Each receives event.payload as typed props.
Icon color per type: journal=blue, milestone=yellow, github_commit=gray, github_release=purple, progress=green, points=orange, status=gray. Use Tailwind text-* classes.
Perform actions to generate each event type. Open timeline — verify all 8 types render with correct icons and data.
